title: Shemirat Halashon 34

chapters.title: Prohibition of accepting rechilut
chapters.about: Rules against accepting negative talk as true

chapters.title: The power of lashon hara and Doeg HaAdomi
chapters.about: Discussion of the three people harmed by lashon hara

chapters.title: Protecting oneself from a threat
chapters.about: When listening or asking is permitted for self-defense

chapters.title: Chizkat kashrut and innocent until proven guilty
chapters.about: Maintaining the presumption of innocence regarding others

chapters.title: Limits on reacting to a plot
chapters.about: Restrictions on preemptive actions and hatred

summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through laws of rechilut and accepting negative talk, focusing on how to handle hearing that someone is plotting against you. He explains the limits of what a person may believe and the obligation to protect oneself while maintaining a presumption of innocence.
questions: Am I allowed to believe someone who tells me that another person is talking about me?
What should I do if I hear that someone is planning to cause me harm?
Can I take preemptive action against someone I hear is plotting against me?
Am I allowed to hate someone who is planning to do something bad to me?
